title: Fix ISSUE-054 regression: guard literature stale-job cleanup with RunLock
done_items: Ported RunLock (fcntl.flock) to adapters/locks.py, added AppConfig.literature_job_lock_path, guarded LiteratureJobRunner stale cleanup & job execution with cross-process lock, and wired api.py and mcp_extensions.py (ISSUE-057).
